item.title: Gold, silver surge as market volatility fuels safe-haven demand
item.description: Precious metals advanced sharply on Wednesday, with gold climbing back above the $5,200 mark as investors returned to safe-haven assets amid continued volatility linked to tensions in the Middle East, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: Leyla Aliyeva visits Narimanov Children's Clinical Hospital of Republican Pediatric Center
item.description: Leyla Aliyeva visited the Narimanov Children's Clinical Hospital of the Republican Pediatric Center.

item.title: James Cameron exhibition opens in Stockholm
item.description: The exhibition Challenging the Deep, dedicated to deep-sea expeditions and the films of James Cameron, has opened at the Vasa Museum in Stockholm, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: Non-oil exports climb as Baku pushes post-petro growth model
item.description: Active participation of both public and private companies in non-oil exports is noteworthy. The role of the state should be to provide infrastructure, financial support, and access to export markets. The private sector, meanwhile, should focus on increasing efficiency, applying innovations, and producing goods that meet market demand.

item.title: ILO and ITU warn of AI risks for workers
item.description: The introduction of artificial intelligence technologies is increasingly reshaping working conditions across a wide range of sectors—from content moderators and data annotation specialists to couriers and drivers operating on digital platforms, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: 90 families return to Aghdam as Azerbaijan’s Great Return Program continues
item.description: The return of former internally displaced persons to Azerbaijan’s liberated territories continues under the Great Return program implemented in accordance with the instructions of President Ilham Aliyev.

item.title: New York Post highlights Heydar Aliyev Center as international art destination
item.description: The renowned publication New York Post has reported on the transformation of the Heydar Aliyev Center into a global center for art and culture, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: US-Israeli forces continue attacks on Iran: UK clarifies drone hitting base in Cyprus wasn't launched by Tehran
item.description: Turkish Ministry of Defense reported that a ballistic missile launched from Iran and headed towards Turkiye was neutralized by NATO forces stationed in the Eastern Mediterranean.

item.title: Azeri Light oil price falls in global markets
item.description: The price of Azerbaijan’s Azeri Light crude oil has declined in international markets, reflecting broader downward trends in global oil prices.

item.title: China plans to increase defense budget by 7% in 2026
item.description: China plans to increase its defense spending by 7 percent in 2026, bringing the total military budget to 1.909 trillion yuan (approximately $277 billion), according to a draft document presented to the country’s legislature.
